cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
前 12 天每天只有 1–4 星
agent-desktop 突然日增 2,680
cover.dek: Vercel Labs 这个项目靠读系统无障碍树做桌面 computer use，不靠截图猜像素。倒数第二天 +844，昨天 +2,270，是今天最陡的一条曲线。
cover.title_en:
12 days at 1–4 stars a day,
then agent-desktop jumped to +2,680
cover.dek_en: Vercel Labs' project drives the desktop by reading the system accessibility tree instead of guessing at screenshot pixels. It went +844 the day before last and +2,270 yesterday, the steepest curve on the board today.

stickers.title: 记忆升温
stickers.text: claude-mem 日增 +1,523，此前长期每天只有 170–340 颗星。
stickers.text_en: claude-mem gained +1,523 stars in a day, up from a long-running 170–340 a day.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: 2610.34577 比较了 17 种验证设计，独立 critic 复审性价比最高。
stickers.text_en: Paper 2610.34577 compared 17 verification designs and found an independent critic review the best value.

stickers.title: 监管信号
stickers.text: HN 上 Anthropic 阻止 Claude 逆向游戏的帖子拿到 171 分、105 条评论。
stickers.text_en: The HN post on Anthropic moving to stop Claude from reverse-engineering games drew 171 points and 105 comments.
